Amumu.escape: Engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is used. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap and catch him with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.
Amumu.laning: Viego has a hard time getting close when ganking alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, look for an opportunity when the enemy has pushed near your allied turret.
Amumu.build: Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage taken, so build armor penetration first when facing him. Build magic resistance against his magic damage. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stuns you, and he can follow up at close range with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. When Amumu has his ultimate, don’t group with allies or fight in narrow paths. Keep a minion or jungle monster between you and Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
Amumu.combo: When engaging, cast Viego E Harrowed Path and approach, then stun the target with Viego W Spectral Maw and land Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after landing your abilities. When a target is within kill range, finish them with Viego R Heartbreaker.
Amumu.fight: After Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down, use Viego E Harrowed Path to approach and take a short trade. Catch him with Viego W Spectral Maw, land Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, and weave in basic attacks, but don’t stay near Amumu W Despair for long.
Amumu.phase: In the mid game, when Viego’s items come online, look for a first takedown that you can turn into a possession. In late-game head-on team fights, don’t engage first.
Amumu.teamfight: After Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy has been used on an ally and an enemy becomes killable, engage to secure the first corpse. Possess them with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, use the basic abilities you gain while healing, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.

Shaco.fight: Right after Shaco appears with Q Deceive, focus the real Shaco with your allies. Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, land Viego W Spectral Maw, then weave in basic attacks after your abilities to make the most of Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King's damage. If Shaco uses R Hallucinate, do not pour damage into the clone; identify the real Shaco by watching how the health bars react.
Shaco.build: Prepare a Control Ward and Oracle Lens first to clear Shaco W Jack In The Box boxes around objectives. Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate. Also build health to avoid dropping into the health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals increased damage.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco Q Deceive is down, approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks. Use Viego R Heartbreaker when you need to close the distance further or finish the real Shaco after his health has dropped.
Shaco.escape: Right after Shaco reveals himself with Q Deceive is your chance to go in. Close in with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker along a path where you can avoid the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, and kill him with your allies.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco's ganks and invades. Viego should prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, look for a gank when an opponent pushes near an allied turret. Before starting an objective, check for and clear nearby Shaco W Jack In The Box boxes.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks for an advantage through ganks and invades, so maintain vision, avoid giving him a kill, and secure objectives. In the mid game, as Viego's items come together, he can pick off someone in a small fight and continue the fight through possession. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in isolated fights, but Viego should still avoid going in first in a front-to-front teamfight.
Shaco.teamfight: If Shaco engages with Q Deceive, focus the real Shaco with your allies immediately to create the first corpse. Go in after the opponent's crowd control is used on an allied tank, then possess with Viego P Sovereign's Domination to heal and use the abilities you gain along with Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else. Before the possession ends, secure the next kill or move to safety.
Shaco.watch: If Shaco gets behind you with Q Deceive, his empowered basic attack is dangerous, so stand with your back to a wall or face your allies when you think he is nearby. Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives. When Shaco R Hallucinate's clone dies, move away from the explosion and boxes.

Ekko.phase: Viego’s early jungle clear is comfortable since it costs no resources, but check that Ekko’s mobility is down before engaging. The mid game is Viego’s peak as his items come online, so look for a first takedown in a small skirmish around an objective. In late-game front-to-back team fights, going in first can get you killed before you create a corpse to possess.
Ekko.build: After completing your first core item, fit Executioner's Calling into your build to counter the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak. Build magic resistance over armor against Ekko’s damage. If the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence lets him land his full combo, prioritize tenacity.
Ekko.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path. The moment Ekko E Phase Dive has been spent, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw and use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in empowered basic attacks after landing your abilities. Before using Viego R Heartbreaker, keep in mind that it targets the champion with the lowest remaining health percentage.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, Ekko can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don’t commit too far. Close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw to force out Ekko R Chronobreak or look for a takedown. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, track the afterimage’s position, and don’t chase deep just because Ekko is low on health.
Ekko.laning: Viego’s only ways to close the gap alone are Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego E Harrowed Path, so prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If you don’t have that setup, engage when Ekko pushes near your allied turret, and cast Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along the gank route ahead of time.
Ekko.teamfight: Engage after enemy crowd control has been used on an allied tank and a target becomes killable. Before the possession ends, use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid its area to prevent the stun and shield. Move out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. When you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t overcommit to chasing, even under low-health conditions.

Belveth.teamfight: Engage after enemy crowd control has been used on an allied tank and a target becomes killable, securing the first corpse. If an ally goes down and Bel'Veth can claim Void Coral, fall back. Delay the fight while Bel'Veth is transformed by Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. If you possess a target, use the basic abilities you gain, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.
Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage, so build armor first. Health is needed against the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, which resistances can’t block. If Bel'Veth’s healing is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Belveth.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after landing your abilities to trigger additional attacks. If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw or wait for it to end before focusing your damage.
Belveth.escape: After dodging Bel'Veth W Above and Below and once Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down, engage with the stun from Viego W Spectral Maw. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so one dash doesn’t mean all her movement options are gone. Keep this in mind when closing the gap with Viego R Heartbreaker, too.
Belveth.fight: Slow Bel'Veth’s growth by stealing camps through early jungle skirmishes and invades, while her permanent stacks are still low. In fights, sidestep Bel'Veth W Above and Below and don’t unload heavy damage into Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Focus on a killable target and turn it into a possession with Viego P Sovereign's Domination.
Belveth.laning: When ganking, prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, look for an opportunity when the enemy pushes near your allied turret. Cast Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along the approach route ahead of time, then approach through the mist.
Belveth.phase: Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come online, so look for a first takedown in small skirmishes around objectives. Bel'Veth gains an advantage over time from her permanent stacks, and it’s dangerous for Viego to engage first in late-game head-on team fights.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks up and slows, and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, so sidestep when she closes in. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces incoming damage, so use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker after it ends, or interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw.

MonkeyKing.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun Wukong with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in empowered basic attacks after hitting your abilities. When Wukong uses Wukong W Warrior Trickster, don’t attack the clone left in place; identify the real Wukong and continue your combo.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first to prepare for Wukong’s main damage. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, so also focus on avoiding his empowered basic attack. If healing from Wukong P Stone Skin becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
MonkeyKing.escape: Don’t rush in when only Wukong E Nimbus Strike is down, because he can still use Wukong W Warrior Trickster to escape. In particular, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker before Wukong W Warrior Trickster is available again. The moment after Wukong R Cyclone is also down is an opportunity to start a fight or contest an objective.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin stacks armor and healing the longer you fight, so repeat short trades and back off. Close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker when Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down. Secure a takedown on a target you can finish to create a chance to heal with Viego P Sovereign's Domination.
MonkeyKing.laning: Viego has limited ways to close the gap alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. Without it, engage when the enemy pushes close to your allied turret. If Wukong W Warrior Trickster is still available, check the direction the real Wukong is moving so you don’t waste abilities on the clone.
MonkeyKing.phase: Early on, take advantage of Viego’s resource-free jungle clear, and don’t fight Wukong for long. The mid game, when Viego has items, is his strong phase, so pick someone in a small skirmish and chain into possession. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, delay your engage because Viego can be taken down before creating the first corpse if he goes in first.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Wait until the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allied tank and a target can be killed, then go in to secure the first corpse. While possessing a champion, use their basic abilities, then target your next victim with Viego R Heartbreaker or move to safety before the duration ends.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike targets you, so you can’t dodge it; keep your distance outside its range. The clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster stays in place, so don’t waste Viego W Spectral Maw on it. Watch which direction the real Wukong is heading.

Evelynn.laning: Ward beside the jungle camps where Evelynn might start a fight, and prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If there are no such lanes, look for an opportunity when the enemy pushes up near an allied turret.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn Q Hate Spike, Evelynn W Allure, and Evelynn E Whiplash. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, so even after buying your items, prioritize backing away before the mark matures. If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Evelynn.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, then stun with Viego W Spectral Maw and use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after hitting abilities to make use of the extra attack from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Against a fleeing Evelynn, fire Viego W Spectral Maw with a short charge, and only charge it longer when you can reliably hit her.
Evelynn.escape: Do not engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down. If Evelynn R Last Caress is also down and has not come off cooldown yet, use the opening to close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker. If Evelynn W Allure has already marked you, first back away before the mark matures.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance until the Evelynn W Allure mark matures. If Evelynn engages, look for a chance to stun her with Viego W Spectral Maw. Viego needs a first takedown to heal through possession and keep fighting, so engage when a target is within kill range.
Evelynn.phase: Mid game, as your items come together, is a strong time for Viego, so look for a first takedown in skirmishes around objectives. In late-game head-on team fights, delay your engage because going in first can get Viego killed before he creates a corpse.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets backline damage dealers, so wait for her engage where your team has vision and save Viego W Spectral Maw to stop her. Stun Evelynn right after she dives in; if you secure a first kill, possess a fallen enemy with Viego P Sovereign's Domination to heal and keep fighting. Before the possession ends, either take down your next target or move to a safe position.
Evelynn.watch: When Evelynn W Allure marks you, she is preparing a charm nearby. Back away before the mark matures and alert your allies. Evelynn E Whiplash after the charm deals damage based on the target's maximum health, so avoid narrow paths along walls. When health has decreased, beware the heavy damage from Evelynn R Last Caress and stay out of areas without vision.

Udyr.laning: Ward key routes and jungle entrances to watch Udyr’s gank paths. Don’t push up in lane while Udyr is out of sight. Prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control; otherwise, look for an opportunity when the enemy pushes up near an allied turret.
Udyr.build: After completing one core item, fit Executioner's Calling into your build to counter the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Prioritize armor for resistance. However, armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types.
Udyr.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing a skill, weave in basic attacks. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, hold Viego W Spectral Maw and use it after the empowered state ends.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use E Blazing Stampede, you have a window to close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If you’ve already taken the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, fight back or escape during the period when Udyr cannot stun you again with it.
Udyr.fight: Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, pressure him without giving him time to heal. After you take one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, Udyr cannot stun you again with it for a while, giving you a chance to fight back. After hitting with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, weave in basic attacks to deal damage.
Udyr.phase: Early, use Viego’s resource-free jungle clear and track Udyr’s pathing with vision. Mid game, as Viego completes items, is his peak, so look to secure a definite pick in a small fight around an objective and trigger a possession. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, delay your engage because you can die before creating the first corpse if you go in first.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t force a fight to take down Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. Go in after enemy crowd control is used on an allied tank and an enemy you can kill appears, then secure the first corpse. If you possess with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, use the basic abilities you gain, then target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker before the possession ends or retreat to safety.
Udyr.watch: Be wary of the stun on Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s first attack right after it activates. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay close and take hits for long. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so use Viego W Spectral Maw after the empowered state ends.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar’s main damage. Avoid getting hit by Briar Q Head Rush, which reduces your armor. After completing one core item, Viego should slot in Executioner's Calling to reduce Briar’s healing.
Briar.combo: Cast Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along the gank route ahead of time and approach, then stun with Viego W Spectral Maw and use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in empowered basic attacks after landing your abilities. If Briar starts charging Briar E Chilling Scream, use Viego W Spectral Maw then to interrupt the healing and the wall stun.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death also give her ways to close the gap, so look especially for an opportunity before Briar R Certain Death is available again. If you interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream’s charge with Viego W Spectral Maw, you can close the gap with Viego R Heartbreaker during that opening.
Briar.fight: If you meet Briar in the jungle, you can take her health down and delay her next route. If she charges at you nearby with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, respond by stunning her with Viego W Spectral Maw. When you have a kill opportunity, secure the first takedown and heal by possessing the target with Viego P Sovereign's Domination.
Briar.laning: Viego has a hard time ganking successfully alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, look for an opportunity when the enemy pushes near your allied turret. Keep vision around the lanes to prepare for Briar’s ganks, and don’t stay long in areas without vision.
Briar.phase: Briar is heavily involved in early ganks, so secure vision and look for opportunities to counter-engage when she commits too far. The mid game, when Viego’s items come online, is his peak, so look for a first takedown in a small skirmish around an objective. In late-game head-on team fights, delay your engage, as going in first can get you killed before you create a corpse.
Briar.teamfight: Have your frontline stand in the path of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to protect your backline carries, and have them position to take Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone first as well. Viego should engage after enemy crowd control has been used on an allied tank and a target becomes killable. After the first takedown, possess the target with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, then take down someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.
Briar.watch: While Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is active, she chases the nearest enemy, so position yourself in front of your allied carries to intercept her. When Briar E Chilling Scream begins charging, interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw. Don’t stand with your back to a wall, so a fully charged scream can’t knock you into one and stun you. If Briar R Certain Death targets you, move toward your allies and fight together instead of only running away.

Hecarim.build: Complete one core item first, then slot in Executioner's Calling to reduce healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread. Against Hecarim’s main damage, Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge, build armor first for resistances.
Hecarim.fight: When Hecarim approaches, disrupt his movement with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker, also reducing the attack damage he gains from Hecarim P Warpath.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run, so break vision or move toward your allies when he turns and starts charging. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, he heals based on damage taken nearby, so burst him quickly or move out of its range. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so spread out during teamfights.
Hecarim.combo: Precast Viego E Harrowed Path along a wall to approach, then stop Hecarim with Viego W Spectral Maw and hit him with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in empowered basic attacks after hitting abilities. When Hecarim's health decreases, finish him with Viego R Heartbreaker, but first check whether there is a nearby champion with a lower remaining health percentage.
Hecarim.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge alone is down. Look for a window when Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows has also been used or is still on cooldown, then close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker.
Hecarim.laning: Viego should prioritize ganking lanes where his allies have crowd control. If there is no such lane, gank when the enemy pushes near your allied turret.
Hecarim.phase: Mid game, as your items come together, is Viego's peak, so look for a first takedown in skirmishes around objectives. In late-game head-on team fights, delay your engage because going in first can get Viego killed before he creates a corpse to possess.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows does not fear multiple teammates. Wait until the enemy's crowd control has been used on your allied tank and a target becomes killable, then engage to secure the first corpse. Possess with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, use the basic abilities you gain, and before possession ends, either target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker or move to a safe position.

Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, casting Viego W Spectral Maw first will have its stun blocked and further increase Nocturne’s attack speed. Break the shield with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, then look to stun with Viego W Spectral Maw. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks and secure a kill to create an opportunity to heal with Viego P Sovereign's Domination.
Nocturne.build: Nocturne’s main damage from P Umbra Blades, Q Duskbringer, and R Paranoia is physical, so build armor first. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Nocturne’s healing feels strong, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Nocturne.combo: Approach using Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along your route. If the shield from Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still up, break it first with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, then stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw. Weave in basic attacks between skills, and use Viego R Heartbreaker when you can finish him.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is also down, close the gap and engage with Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror has connected, save your mobility spell to break the tether instead of using it to engage.
Nocturne.laning: Maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances, and position yourself with somewhere to retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia activates. Viego has difficulty closing in alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If your allies have no such crowd control, engage when the enemy pushes near your allied turret.
Nocturne.phase: Mid game, as Viego completes items, is his peak, so look for the first takedown in a small fight around an objective. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, don’t go in first; wait until a target you can kill appears.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don’t scatter; immediately group with your allies. Once the enemy’s crowd control is used on an allied tank and a target you can kill appears, engage and secure the first possession with Viego P Sovereign's Domination. During possession, use the basic abilities you gain, then target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker before it ends or retreat to safety.
Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, he can quickly follow along the trail it leaves. Don’t run straight away; angle toward an ally or turret. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, the fear will trigger, so be ready to create distance with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.

Brand.build: Build movement speed first so you can get out of Brand’s telegraphed attack zones. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Brand.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, and land Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in empowered basic attacks after landing your abilities. When Brand’s health has decreased, finish him with Viego R Heartbreaker, keeping in mind that it hits the nearby champion with the lowest health percentage.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so engage right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. If you aren’t ablaze, Brand Q Sear can’t stun you, so close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.
Brand.fight: After dodging Brand W Pillar of Flame, close the gap while Brand has no Blaze. Brand has no mobility and tends to have low armor, making him an easy target for Viego’s physical damage once you get close. Stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw, then follow with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and basic attacks.
Brand.laning: Don’t last-hit beside a burning minion; approach from the side of the wave. When ganking with Viego, prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, look for an opportunity when Brand has pushed near your allied turret. Before engaging, cast Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall and approach through the mist.
Brand.phase: In the early game, Viego can jungle without spending resources while looking for gank opportunities. The mid game, when his items come online, is Viego’s peak, so pick someone off in a small skirmish around an objective and turn it into a possession. In late-game head-on team fights, delay your engage, as going in first can get you killed before you create the first corpse.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm don’t spread to your allies, and don’t stand beside an ally who is ablaze. After enemy crowd control has been used on an allied tank and a target becomes killable, Viego should engage to secure the first corpse. If you possess them with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, use the basic abilities you gain, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks and explodes when you’re hit by abilities in quick succession, so dodge his first ability. Avoid Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you’re ablaze, dodge the Brand Q Sear projectile or stand behind a minion to avoid the stun. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from allies to reduce its bouncing damage.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s primary ability damage. Also consider armor because her basic attacks deal damage too. If the healing from Elise P Spider Queen is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Elise.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, land Viego W Spectral Maw, then follow with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after landing your abilities to take advantage of the follow-up attack from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. While Elise E Rappel has her airborne, wait for her to land before following up with your next attack.
Elise.escape: The opening to engage comes right after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down. You can also close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker right after Elise dashes in with Elise Q Venomous Bite. Take advantage of the shorter escape distance after Elise E Rappel if there are no nearby enemy units for her to move to.
Elise.fight: Engage back once both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down. Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path and stun her with Viego W Spectral Maw, weaving basic attacks between abilities to deal damage. Focus on a killable target to create the first corpse for a possession with Viego P Sovereign's Domination.
Elise.laning: Elise builds an early lead through ganks, so keep ample vision early and don’t push the lane too far when you can’t see her. Prioritize lanes with allied crowd control; if there are none, gank when the enemy pushes near your allied turret. It’s also important to stand behind the minion line to block Elise E Cocoon.
Elise.phase: In the early game, watch for Elise looking to build a lead through ganks, avoid giving up kills, and stall for time. The mid game is Viego’s peak as his items come online, so pick someone off in a small skirmish around an objective and turn it into a possession. In late-game front-to-back team fights, don’t engage first; wait until a target becomes killable.
Elise.teamfight: Engage after enemy crowd control has been used on an allied tank and a target becomes killable. After killing the first target, basic attack the wraith to possess it with Viego P Sovereign's Domination. Use the basic abilities you gain, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else. Before the possession ends, take down another target or move to safety.
Elise.watch: At full health, watch out for Elise Q Neurotoxin. After health has decreased, if Elise transforms with Elise R Spider Form, watch out for Elise Q Venomous Bite. When you see her transform, be ready to use Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker in response to her closing in for a finishing attack.

Fiddlesticks.build: After completing one core item, fit Executioner's Calling into your build to reduce the healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. Build magic resistance against Fiddlesticks’ damage, and use the movement speed from Viego E Harrowed Path to get out of Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm’s area.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after landing your abilities. If you may need to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, save Viego W Spectral Maw for that moment.
Fiddlesticks.escape: After Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap have been used, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw to reduce its healing and limit the opportunity for its next cast.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there’s no such setup, gank when the enemy pushes near your allied turret, and keep vision in the brush behind the lane to prepare for Fiddlesticks’ ambush.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come online, so look for a first takedown in a small skirmish around an objective. In the late game, don’t engage first in a head-on team fight; wait until a target becomes killable.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Spread out so you aren’t hit together by Fiddlesticks’ area abilities, and don’t group up to engage through a narrow path where you have no vision. After crowd control has been used on an allied tank, go in to secure a kill on one target and possess the target with Viego P Sovereign's Domination. Use the basic abilities you gain while possessing them, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.
Fiddlesticks.watch: When you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, interrupt it with a stun from Viego W Spectral Maw. If you can’t interrupt it, leave the area. Be wary of brush without vision and narrow paths when Fiddlesticks hasn’t been seen for a long time.

Gragas.build: Complete one core item first, then fit Executioner's Calling in if healing from Gragas P Happy Hour is preventing kills. Build magic resistance rather than armor to resist Gragas's damage. Since Gragas tends to have high armor, consider penetration when increasing your damage.
Gragas.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, then stun with Viego W Spectral Maw and hit Gragas with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks each time you hit an ability to get the extra attack. Engage after Gragas E Body Slam is down, and use a short cast of Viego W Spectral Maw to stick to a fleeing Gragas.
Gragas.escape: The moment after Gragas E Body Slam is down is your window to engage. Close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you, do not counterattack there; first move outside the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll.
Gragas.fight: When Gragas starts drinking with W Drunken Rage, he takes reduced damage, so briefly hold off on your burst. Bait out Gragas E Body Slam, then close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. Weave in basic attacks after hitting abilities to make the most of the extra attack from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King.
Gragas.laning: Viego has limited ways to engage alone, so prioritize ganking lanes where your allies have crowd control. If there is no such lane, engage when Gragas pushes the lane near your allied turret. Precast Viego E Harrowed Path along a wall on your approach, and avoid the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll.
Gragas.phase: Gragas has strong burst and formation disruption in the early and mid game, so hold your formation and weather objective fights during this period. Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come together, and a takedown lets him continue the fight with Viego P Sovereign's Domination. Gragas's sustained damage falls off in the late game, but Viego is also at risk if he engages a head-on team fight first, so delay your engage.
Gragas.teamfight: Engage after Gragas E Body Slam is used on an allied tank and a target becomes killable. After your first takedown, basic attack the wraith to heal through Viego P Sovereign's Domination and use the possessed champion's basic abilities. Before possession ends, use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to a safe position.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If you are near the barrel and also get hit by Gragas E Body Slam, you are likely to get hit by both abilities. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, do not stand with an enemy turret or enemy territory behind you.

Graves.build: Graves's main damage is physical, so build armor first and buy Plated Steelcaps earlier. Armor does not block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after hitting abilities to trigger the passive on Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. If Graves uses a mobility ability to create distance and health has decreased, chase with Viego R Heartbreaker, but first check which target the ultimate will hit.
Graves.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Graves E Quickdraw alone is down. In the window when Graves R Collateral Damage is also down, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If you are inside Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area before engaging.
Graves.fight: Minions or allies between you and Graves can block Graves P New Destiny's basic attack after it hits the first unit. When Graves fires both shots and reloads, close the gap with Viego E Harrowed Path and counterattack.
Graves.laning: Push or pressure the lane from the early game to limit Graves's chances to build up the scaling stacks from Graves E Quickdraw. Viego has trouble closing the gap when ganking alone, so prioritize lanes where your allies have crowd control.
Graves.phase: It is better to keep Graves's scaling in check early. Mid game, as your items come together, is a strong time for Viego, so look for a first takedown in skirmishes around objectives. Graves's scaling stacks put you at a disadvantage as the game goes on, and it is hard for Viego to create the first corpse if he engages a late-game head-on team fight first.
Graves.teamfight: Do not start team fights as Viego. Wait until the enemy's crowd control has been used on your allied tank, then engage on a target you can kill. After your first takedown, basic attack the wraith to possess it with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, then use the basic abilities you gain and target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker. Before possession ends, either secure another takedown or move to a safe position.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid standing with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle choke. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, it blocks your vision and slows you; escape by the shortest route, then re-engage.

Ivern.build: The more dangerous situation is allies following up on the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!, rather than Ivern's own damage, so prioritize tenacity. If building resistance, choose magic resistance over armor, and also get movement speed to leave the warned attack areas.
Ivern.combo: Precast Viego E Harrowed Path along a wall to approach. When Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw and hit him with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after hitting abilities to make use of the extra attack. Before using Viego R Heartbreaker, check that the champion with the lowest remaining health percentage is your intended target.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is his only mobility ability, so close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker immediately after it has been used. In team fights, wait until crowd control such as Ivern Q Rootcaller has been used on your allied tank and a target becomes killable before engaging.
Ivern.fight: Right after dodging Ivern Q Rootcaller or baiting it out, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on a target, wait for the shield to burst; once you’re close, weave basic attacks between abilities. Rather than chasing Ivern too far, prioritize an allied target you can kill to create a chance to possess with Viego P Sovereign's Domination.
Ivern.laning: Prioritize ganking lanes where your allies have crowd control; if there are none, look for the moment the enemy pushes toward your allied turret. Watch out beside newly created Ivern W Brushmaker, and clear vision in that spot.
Ivern.phase: Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come together, so pick someone off in a skirmish around an objective and follow up with a possession. In late-game head-on team fights, delay your engage because going in first can get you killed before you create a corpse.
Ivern.teamfight: Ivern R Daisy! can take ability hits in place of another target, so do not cast Viego W Spectral Maw at an enemy behind Daisy. After the enemy's crowd control has been used on your allied tank, pick off a target you can kill and possess it with Viego P Sovereign's Domination to heal. Use the basic abilities you gain during possession, then before it ends, either target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker or move to a safe position.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, his allies can dash in, so position minions or terrain between you and him before he fires. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid her repeated attacks and knock-up. Do not engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until the shield bursts.

JarvanIV.build: If you can reduce attack speed, it helps reduce the damage you take from basic attacks.
JarvanIV.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then hit with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and weave in basic attacks.
JarvanIV.laning: Viego has a low gank success rate alone, so prioritize lanes where your allies have crowd control. If they do not, look for an opening when the enemy pushes the lane close to your allied turret.

Jax.build: Jax's damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so first consider defensive options that reduce attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike also deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Jax.combo: After confirming Jax E Counter Strike has ended, approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after hitting abilities to make use of the extra hit from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. When Jax's health decreases, finish him with Viego R Heartbreaker, but first check whether there is a nearby champion with a lower health percentage.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to close the gap or pick him off. If Jax E Counter Strike is also down, engage by closing in with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If Jax closes in while Counter Strike is active, do not immediately use your mobility ability; use it when needed to leave the stun radius.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Do not basic attack during Counter Strike; wait outside the stun radius, then stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw and follow up with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and basic attacks.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so do not force an engage when you only have one ability. Viego has trouble ganking alone, so look for a lane where your allies have crowd control or where Jax has pushed near your allied turret.
Jax.phase: Mid game, as your items come together, is Viego's peak; do not enter frontal teamfights first in the late game.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, do not group up and get caught in its area stun. Just after Counter Strike ends and the stun wears off, lock Jax down with Viego W Spectral Maw, but let your allies absorb the engage first and look for a target you can kill. Once you get the first takedown, possess with Viego P Sovereign's Domination to heal, then use the abilities you gain and Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, it negates basic attacks and their on-hit damage, and its reactivation damage increases with each attack dodged. Stop basic attacking during it and move outside the stun radius, then fight after Counter Strike ends. Since Jax can close in with Jax Q Leap Strike, save Viego W Spectral Maw to manage the distance.

Karthus.build: Build magic resistance before armor to prepare for the damage from Karthus Q Lay Waste, Karthus E Defile, and Karthus R Requiem. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your resistance, so also get movement speed to dodge the attacks he telegraphs and leave the wall behind.
Karthus.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun Karthus with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave basic attacks after each ability hit, and finish Karthus with Viego R Heartbreaker when his health has decreased. Move away from the corpse when Karthus P Death Defied activates.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so you can close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If Karthus W Wall of Pain has been placed, don’t enter through the wall; approach along a route that avoids it.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no way to create distance, so use Viego E Harrowed Path to approach and engage when you land Viego W Spectral Maw. After hitting your abilities, weave in basic attacks to make use of Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King’s extra attack. Even after killing Karthus, don’t keep fighting near the corpse; reposition immediately.
Karthus.laning: When ganking, prioritize lanes with allied crowd control and approach by casting Viego E Harrowed Path on the wall along your entry route. Without allied crowd control, look for an opportunity when Karthus pushes the lane close to your allied turret.
Karthus.phase: Viego is strong in the mid game once he has items, so secure the first takedown in small skirmishes and chain it into Viego P Sovereign's Domination. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, delay your engage because Viego can be taken down before creating the first corpse if he goes in first.
Karthus.teamfight: Wait until the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allied tank and a target can be killed before Viego engages. After the first takedown, heal with Viego P Sovereign's Domination and use the possessed champion’s basic abilities. Before the possession ends, use Viego R Heartbreaker either to target the next enemy or to retreat to a safe position. If you kill Karthus, immediately move away from the corpse to avoid attacks while Karthus P Death Defied is active.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals heavy damage when it hits you alone, so watch its blast radius and walk out of it. If possible, stand on top of an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. Don’t stay in Karthus E Defile for long. Keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem after a fight, and move away from the corpse immediately when Karthus P Death Defied activates.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If a long fight makes the healing from Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will a problem, get healing reduction.
LeeSin.combo: Cast Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along your entry route, then approach through the mist. When Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw and hit him with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after hitting your abilities, and use Viego R Heartbreaker on a target you can kill.
LeeSin.escape: The window before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike becomes available again is your chance to engage. If Lee Sin has also used Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to move, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. Don’t rush in if only one of Lee Sin’s movement abilities is down, since he can still escape with the other.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early on, don’t take the duel; back away. Close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike has missed or is unavailable, and Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is also down. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks to make the most of Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King’s extra attack.
LeeSin.laning: Viego has a hard time ganking alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are no such lanes, look for an opening when the enemy pushes close to your allied turret.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back away if you meet him in the jungle and take advantages in lane and around objectives instead. Viego is strong in the mid game once he has items, so look for a clean pick in small skirmishes around objectives and go for a possession. Lee Sin falls off late, but Viego is also at risk if he enters a front-to-front teamfight first, so follow the proper engage order.
LeeSin.teamfight: After your front line has absorbed the enemy’s crowd control, Viego should go in on a target he can kill to create the first corpse. Before the fight, keep some distance so you don’t collide with allies knocked back by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If you possess a champion, use their basic abilities. Before the possession ends, use Viego R Heartbreaker either to move to your next target or to retreat to a safe position.
LeeSin.watch: If health is below half, stay close to an allied turret or the team while the second hit is available. Stand away from walls, since Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will can take him over a wall where you have no vision.

MasterYi.build: Build health to withstand the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, and consider ways to reduce his attack speed. If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate becomes a problem, fit in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
MasterYi.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, but save Viego W Spectral Maw until Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands. Stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw immediately after he lands, hit him with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, then weave in basic attacks. When securing a kill, check that Viego R Heartbreaker will hit the nearby champion with the lowest percentage of health remaining.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is his only mobility ability, so right after he uses it is your window to close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. Don’t cast your abilities too early during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike; watch where he lands, then engage.
MasterYi.fight: You can look for a fight if you meet Master Yi in the jungle early on. Stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, hit him with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, then weave in basic attacks. If Master Yi activates Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt him with the Viego W Spectral Maw stun you saved.
MasterYi.laning: When ganking, prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. Without it, look for an opening when the enemy pushes close to your allied turret. Master Yi has weak ganks early, so secure early objectives quickly as well.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so disrupt his growth with fights and objectives. Viego is strongest in the mid game once he has items, so pick someone in a small skirmish and chain into Viego P Sovereign's Domination. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, and Viego is also at risk if he enters a late-game front-to-front teamfight first, so don’t rush your engage.
MasterYi.teamfight: Have your team absorb Master Yi Q Alpha Strike’s initial engage, then layer immobilizing crowd control right after he lands to prevent his takedown participation. Viego should wait until the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allied tank and a target can be killed, then go in to secure the first corpse. If you possess a champion with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, use their basic abilities. Before the possession ends, use Viego R Heartbreaker either to target the next enemy or to retreat to a safe position.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so hit him with Viego W Spectral Maw right after he lands. Master Yi E Wuju Style adds true damage to his basic attacks while active, so don’t stay in range and take hits for long. Slow effects don’t work while Master Yi R Highlander is active, so don’t try to create distance with Viego R Heartbreaker’s slow.

Nidalee.build: Complete one core item first. If the healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge interferes with finishing a target, fit in Executioner's Calling. Build magic resistance rather than armor to resist Nidalee’s damage.
Nidalee.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun Nidalee with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after hitting your abilities to add extra damage. Finish Nidalee with Viego R Heartbreaker when her health drops.
Nidalee.escape: Nidalee has no crowd control, so the moment after you make her use Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.
Nidalee.fight: If you dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack, you can fight without a Hunt mark. Right after Nidalee W Pounce has been used, catch her with Viego W Spectral Maw and look for a takedown.
Nidalee.laning: When ganking, prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. Without it, look for an opening when the enemy pushes close to your allied turret. Check for Nidalee W Bushwhack traps along the river and jungle entrances before approaching.
Nidalee.phase: Viego’s early jungle clear is comfortable, but keep moving while dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack. The mid game, when Viego has items, is his peak, so look for the first takedown in small skirmishes. Don’t engage first in late-game front-to-front teamfights.
Nidalee.teamfight: Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allied tank and a target can be killed. Remember where Nidalee threw her spear from, then catch her there. After a takedown, basic attack the wraith to possess her with Viego P Sovereign's Domination. Before the possession ends, target your next victim or move to a safe position.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more the farther it travels, so dodge it with minions or your allied front line between you. Nidalee W Bushwhack also leaves a Hunt mark, so be careful around jungle entrances and the river. If she engages with Nidalee W Pounce while you’re marked, be ready to use Viego W Spectral Maw.

Nunu.build: Because of Nunu & Willump Q Consume's healing, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item. Build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump's main damage, and get tenacity to account for the crowd control from the snowball.
Nunu.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks to get the extra attacks. Finish with Viego R Heartbreaker, but check that it will hit the nearby champion with the lowest health percentage.
Nunu.escape: The chance to engage comes after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker to get out before the delayed root triggers. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, look for an angle to interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw's stun.
Nunu.fight: Look for a chance to secure a kill before Nunu & Willump can restore health with Q Consume. After dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever!, close in with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, and attack. Nunu & Willump has no skill to create distance, so keep attacking once you catch them.
Nunu.phase: Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come together, so look for a first kill in small fights around objectives. In late-game frontal teamfights, delay your engage because Viego can be taken down before creating a killable target if he goes in first.
Nunu.teamfight: Viego goes in after Nunu & Willump's crowd control has been used on an allied tank and a killable target appears. Interrupt Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero with Viego W Spectral Maw's stun, or move out of range if you cannot interrupt it. After the first kill, basic attack the wraith to possess it, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so move toward the snowball and escape to where Nunu & Willump has already passed instead of running backward. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, it roots you a moment later, so leave the area immediately. The slow inside Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero grows stronger, so interrupt the channel with Viego W Spectral Maw or move out of range.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. Do not spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, then stun with Viego W Spectral Maw after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends. Follow with Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and weave in basic attacks to make use of the extra attacks. Before finishing with Viego R Heartbreaker, check that it will not target another nearby enemy with a lower health percentage.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use E Heroic Charge is your chance to close in with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. However, if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, hold your dash and go in after it ends. If Poppy is charging R Keeper's Verdict, first move out of her front to avoid being displaced.
Poppy.fight: If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, hold your dash and close in after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Approach with the movement speed from Viego E Harrowed Path, land Viego W Spectral Maw, then weave basic attacks after Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Even if Poppy looks low on health, her armor and magic resistance increase, so only go deep when you can finish her for sure.
Poppy.laning: Prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, gank when an opponent pushes near an allied turret. Use Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along your approach in advance, but position in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge cannot push you into a wall. When Poppy's shield falls, step on it first to keep her from gaining a shield.
Poppy.phase: Viego's early jungle clears are comfortable because they do not require spending resources, but use allied crowd control or an opponent's pushed-up position to gank. Viego peaks in the mid game as his items come together, so pick off someone in a small fight around an objective and follow up with a possession. In late-game frontal teamfights, delay your engage because you can be taken down before creating the first corpse if you go in first.
Poppy.teamfight: Go in after the opponent's crowd control has been used on an allied tank and a killable target appears, then secure the first corpse. After possessing them, use the basic abilities you gain, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.
Poppy.watch: Stand in open space, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you once, walk out of the area before its second explosion. If you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charging, move to the side instead of staying in front of her.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first, considering the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If you keep dying while locked down by crowd control, prioritize tenacity as well.
Rammus.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks, but if Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop basic attacking and attack after it ends.
Rammus.escape: The window after Rammus R Soaring Slam is down is your chance to engage. Wait outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt's range, then close in with Viego W Spectral Maw or R Heartbreaker once the taunt has been used.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop basic attacking and target someone else or wait for its duration to end. Once W is down, approach with Viego E Harrowed Path and focus your damage. Prioritize a target you can kill to create a chance to possess them.
Rammus.laning: Viego should prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, approach with Viego E Harrowed Path when an opponent pushes near an allied turret, and put minions between you and the path of Rammus Q Powerball.
Rammus.phase: Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come together, so look for a first kill in fights around objectives. In the late game, do not go in front first; wait until a killable target appears.
Rammus.teamfight: Move well away when you see Rammus Q Powerball and R Soaring Slam, and target someone else while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active. Go in after the opponent's crowd control is used on an allied tank, secure the first kill, then basic attack the wraith to possess it. Use the basic abilities gained during possession, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before it ends.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him, and move away from the landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam, which can expand. The landing area continues to slow you, so leave it immediately. Do not charge Viego W Spectral Maw within Rammus E Frenzying Taunt's range.

RekSai.build: After finishing one core item, fit Executioner's Calling into your build to reduce the healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai. Build armor first for resistance against Rek'Sai's main damage. Resistance does not work against the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
RekSai.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, and land Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks to make use of Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King's extra attacks. When using Viego W Spectral Maw on a fleeing Rek'Sai, fire it with a short charge to close in instead of charging it for too long.
RekSai.escape: The moment after dodging the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is your chance to go in. Once you confirm Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and Rek'Sai R Void Rush are also down, close in with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.
RekSai.fight: After dodging the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, close in with Viego E Harrowed Path and keep attacking. Do not give Rek'Sai space when she tries to burrow and heal; keep attacking. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so check what movement abilities she has left.
RekSai.laning: Early on, do not walk alone through areas without vision, and avoid giving Rek'Sai a kill with her ganks. Walk over visible Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel tunnels to destroy them. Viego should prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, gank when an opponent pushes near an allied turret.
RekSai.phase: Early on, watch for Rek'Sai's ganks, avoid giving her kills, and buy time. Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come together, so look for a sure kill in a small fight around an objective and aim to possess the target. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, delay your engage because it is hard to create the first corpse if you go in first.
RekSai.teamfight: Wait until an ally takes the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, or Viego dodges it, and a killable target appears before engaging. After the first kill, basic attack the wraith to possess it with Viego P Sovereign's Domination and heal. Use the basic abilities gained during possession, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before it ends.
RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow sends her underground, avoid walls and narrow paths and move in an open direction to prepare for the knock-up. As she emerges, dodge the knock-up with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If Rek'Sai has recently damaged you, stay close to allies in case Rek'Sai R Void Rush comes in.

Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. If the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Rengar.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw and use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks for extra damage. Aim to finish a target you can kill with Viego R Heartbreaker.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, use Viego W Spectral Maw's dash. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down and his Ferocity bar is empty, that is your chance to stun and engage.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's Ferocity bar is empty. Once you confirm Rengar W Battle Roar is down, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw and focus your damage.
Rengar.laning: Avoid paths beside bushes when Rengar is out of sight, and use a Control Ward to get vision in the bushes. Prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control; if there are none, look for a gank when an opponent pushes near an allied turret.
Rengar.phase: Early on, avoid Rengar's leaps from bushes and empowered abilities, and choose your moment to fight. Viego peaks in the mid game as his items come together, so look for a first kill in a small fight around an objective. In the late game, do not go in front first; wait until a killable target appears.
Rengar.teamfight: Position near your frontline and within your team's vision to counter Rengar's engage. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, catch him with Viego W Spectral Maw to secure the first kill, then basic attack the wraith to possess it. Use the basic abilities gained during possession, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before it ends.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator leaps from bushes and builds Ferocity, so avoid paths beside bushes when Rengar is out of sight. At full Ferocity, Rengar E Bola Strike roots its target and Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control, so watch his resource bar before fighting. Be wary of Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and do not roam alone while injured.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first, considering Sejuani's main damage.
Sejuani.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks, and use Viego R Heartbreaker on a target with low enough health to kill. The ultimate automatically hits the nearby champion with the lowest health percentage, so check your target before using it.
Sejuani.escape: Right after you make Sejuani use Q Arctic Assault is your chance to close in with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. Engage when Sejuani R Glacial Prison is also down and no Sejuani E Permafrost stacks have accumulated.
Sejuani.fight: If Sejuani P Fury of the North has increased her defensive stats, damage her first and look for an opening when the defensive effect wears off. Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, approach with Viego E Harrowed Path and close in on an opponent you can kill first. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks to make use of Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King's passive.
Sejuani.laning: Prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, gank when an opponent pushes near an allied turret. Use Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along your approach in advance, follow the mist to close in, and use its camouflage until just before your first ability.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, use Sejuani's weak kill and damage metrics to seek jungle control and objectives. Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come together, so secure the first kill in a small fight around an objective and follow up with a possession. In late-game frontal teamfights, delay your engage because you can be taken down before creating the first corpse if you go in first.
Sejuani.teamfight: Go in after Sejuani's crowd control is used on an allied tank and a killable target appears, then secure the first corpse. Basic attack the wraith to possess it, use the basic abilities you gain, then target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker before the possession ends. If another kill is difficult, move to safety before the possession ends.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault charges and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns you, so move sideways to dodge when you see their tell. If the first hit of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath lands on you, get out of range before its second hit, which concentrates the damage and slow. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can build from basic attacks by melee allies too, so move away when you see the indicator filling.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon's Descent. Her basic attack damage is also high, so build armor too, and account for Shyvana Q Emberstrike and E Molten Burst scaling with maximum health. If the opponent has strong healing, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after completing one core item.
Shyvana.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing your abilities, weave in basic attacks to make use of the extra attacks. If Shyvana is charging with R Dragon's Descent, hold Viego W Spectral Maw until she lands.
Shyvana.escape: After Shyvana's charge with R Dragon's Descent ends and she lands, that is your window to catch her with Viego W Spectral Maw. Also look to engage when Shyvana's Fury bar is empty or her transformation ends and she returns to human form. Once caught, Shyvana has no way to create distance on her own, so close in with Viego R Heartbreaker if you have a chance to kill her.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty, and do not start an objective in front of her if it is full. Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, land Viego W Spectral Maw, then weave in Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and basic attacks to secure a kill.
Shyvana.laning: Invade Shyvana's jungle and take camps before she can build stacks early on, and look to take objectives first. Prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control; if there are none, look for a gank when Shyvana pushes near an allied turret. Use Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall in advance to approach.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, you have an opportunity to pressure Shyvana while she has no stacks, so secure camps and objectives first. Viego is strong in the mid game as his items come together, so look for a first kill in a small fight around an objective. Shyvana grows stronger as she gains stacks, and Viego risks a lot by engaging first in a late-game front-to-front teamfight, so wait until a killable target appears.
Shyvana.teamfight: Keep your team spread out so several allies are not hit together by Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path or her empowered area abilities. Go in after the opponent's crowd control is used on an allied tank and a killable target appears, then secure the first corpse. If you possess with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, use the basic abilities you gain, then use Viego R Heartbreaker to target someone else or move to safety before the possession ends.
Shyvana.watch: Watch out for the slow and maximum-health-based damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst. When Shyvana charges with R Dragon's Descent, do not stand in a way that overlaps with an ally along her path. Shyvana is unstoppable during R Dragon's Descent, so land Viego W Spectral Maw after she lands.

Skarner.build: If you need to remove Skarner R Impale’s suppression, decide whether to buy Quicksilver Sash first. Prioritize magic resistance to counter the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about choosing items that only add health.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw, then land Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing a skill, weave in basic attacks to use the extra attack. When finishing with Viego R Heartbreaker, remember that it automatically hits the nearby champion with the lowest percentage of remaining health.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, you have a window to go in with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If Skarner R Impale is still available, stay wary of getting in suppression range and wait until crowd control is used on an ally or a target you can kill appears before engaging. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact pushes you into a wall and stuns you, retreat while accounting for his next dash.
Skarner.fight: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, look for an opportunity to close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. After landing a skill, weave in basic attacks to make use of the extra attack from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. While Skarner is holding his ground, focus on picking off a target you can kill to trigger Viego P Sovereign's Domination possession instead of fighting him head-on for too long.
Skarner.laning: Viego has difficulty closing in when ganking alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, look for an opportunity when the enemy has pushed near your allied turret. Keep Skarner’s dash in mind and avoid routes with a wall behind you; use Viego E Harrowed Path on a wall along your approach beforehand.
Skarner.phase: Viego can clear the jungle early without spending resources, so secure priority and objectives to delay Skarner’s item timings. Mid game, as Viego completes items, is a strong period for him; picking someone off in a small fight around an objective can lead into a possession. Late game, Skarner gets tankier, while Viego risks dying before creating a corpse if he enters a front-to-front teamfight first.
Skarner.teamfight: Go in after crowd control such as Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale is used on an allied tank and a target you can kill appears. After picking off the first target, possess it with Viego P Sovereign's Domination to heal, use the basic abilities you gain, then target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker before the possession ends. Be careful with your positioning near the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit, where Skarner R Impale can pull you in.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If you keep getting caught by the Taliyah W Seismic Shove and E Unraveled Earth combo, consider tenacity as well.
Taliyah.combo: Approach along a route that goes around the rock field, using Viego E Harrowed Path. Stun Taliyah with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and weave in basic attacks. If Taliyah’s health has dropped, finish her with Viego R Heartbreaker, but first check whether there is a nearby enemy with a lower percentage of remaining health.
Taliyah.escape: Go in after the Taliyah W Seismic Shove and E Unraveled Earth combo is down and you have a route that avoids the rock field. If only one of Taliyah’s mobility tools is down, she can still escape with the other, so look especially for a window before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back. Then close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.
Taliyah.fight: If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, don’t dash in with Viego W Spectral Maw; go around the rock field to close in. Viego’s physical damage is effective against Taliyah’s low armor, so after landing a stun, weave in basic attacks between skills. To prevent her escape, keep dealing damage so she can’t use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.laning: Viego has a low gank success rate alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, wait until Taliyah pushes the lane near your allied turret. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she may affect another lane, so have your allies back off in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Viego’s early jungle clear is comfortable because he spends no resources, but successful ganks require allied crowd control or an enemy pushing forward. Mid game, as Viego completes items, is his peak, so look for the first takedown in small fights. Late game, delay your engage because you can die before creating a corpse if you enter a front-to-front teamfight first.
Taliyah.teamfight: Engage after Taliyah’s crowd control is used on an allied tank and a target you can kill appears. After securing the first takedown, basic attack the wraith to possess it with Viego P Sovereign's Domination and heal. Use the basic abilities you gain during possession, then target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker before it ends or retreat to safety.
Taliyah.watch: If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, Taliyah W Seismic Shove can push you onto the rock field and stun you, so immediately move away from it. Don’t cross the rock field to engage with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change direction while casting, so sidestep it.

Vi.build: Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, W Denting Blows, and E Relentless Force. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stack a lot of health alone, and consider options that reduce attack speed.
Vi.combo: When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun her with W Spectral Maw, then use Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing a skill, weave in basic attacks to make use of the extra attack from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Before using Viego R Heartbreaker on a target you can kill, check whether it will hit the champion with the lowest percentage of remaining health.
Vi.escape: Right after you make Vi use Q Vault Breaker, you have an opportunity to go in with Viego W Spectral Maw or R Heartbreaker. Don’t use Viego W Spectral Maw while Vi R Cease and Desist is coming toward you; use it after landing and after the knock-up ends.
Vi.fight: Hold off on trading while Vi P Blast Shield is active, then fight briefly after the shield is gone. If Vi Q Vault Breaker misses or is used, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw and pick someone off. Don’t let Vi W Denting Blows hit you with repeated attacks for long; create distance.
Vi.laning: Viego has difficulty closing in alone, so prioritize ganking lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, engage when the enemy pushes the lane near your allied turret. Dodge Vi Q Vault Breaker first, then fight after Vi P Blast Shield is gone.
Vi.phase: Viego’s early jungle clear is comfortable because he spends no resources, but you need to dodge Vi Q Vault Breaker before looking for a fight. Mid game, as Viego completes items, is his peak, so look for the first takedown in small fights around objectives. Late game, delay your engage because you can die before creating a corpse if you enter a front-to-front teamfight first.
