Vi.teamfight: While Vi has R Cease and Desist available, make sure backline damage dealers don’t go out of vision alone, and don’t start a teamfight first as Viego. Once Vi’s crowd control is used on an allied tank and a target you can kill appears, go in and secure the first corpse.
Vi.watch: When Vi charges Q Vault Breaker, dodge by moving backward or to the side. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor with repeated attacks, so don’t trade for too long. Vi R Cease and Desist pursues its target to the end and cannot be stopped while dashing, so if it hits you, use Viego W Spectral Maw after the knock-up ends.

Warwick.build: After completing one core item, fit Executioner's Calling into your build to reduce Warwick’s healing. Prioritize magic resistance to account for the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Armor is also valuable because his basic attacks deal physical damage.
Warwick.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun with Viego W Spectral Maw, then use Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Weave in basic attacks after each skill hit to make use of the extra attack. If Warwick E Primal Howl is active, follow this engage sequence after the fear goes off.
Warwick.escape: Don’t go in just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw and R Heartbreaker before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back, ideally after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has also gone off.
Warwick.fight: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, hold your burst and close in again after the fear goes off. Warwick heals more at low health, so don’t dive just because he’s at half health; check whether you can execute him. After landing a skill, weave in basic attacks to make use of Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King’s passive.
Warwick.laning: Prioritize lanes with allied crowd control; if there are none, gank when the enemy pushes near your allied turret. When health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt exposes the location and increases Warwick’s movement and attack speed, so recall even if you have to give up some farming. Take advantage of Warwick’s slow early jungle clear to gain an edge through invades and lane priority.
Warwick.phase: Early, take advantage of Warwick’s slow jungle clear to gain an edge through invades and lane priority. Mid game, as Viego completes items, is his peak, so pick someone off in a small fight around an objective and turn it into a possession. Late game, delay your engage because you can die before creating a corpse if you enter a front-to-front teamfight first.
Warwick.teamfight: Right after Warwick R Infinite Duress is used on an ally, Warwick is held in place, so focus your counterattack. Go in after enemy crowd control is used on an allied tank and a target you can kill appears, then secure the first corpse. After possessing, use the basic abilities you gain, then move to another target with Viego R Heartbreaker before the possession ends or retreat to safety.
Warwick.watch: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and its fear will trigger, so don’t go straight in with Viego W Spectral Maw; back off. Warwick can recast E to trigger the fear early, so close in after the fear goes off. Warwick R Infinite Duress is a suppression and reaches from farther away when his movement speed is higher, so keep your distance from areas without vision during objective standoffs.

XinZhao.build: First complete one core item, then fit Executioner's Calling into your build to counter the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination. Prioritize armor against Xin Zhao’s main damage. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path, stun him with Viego W Spectral Maw, and land Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing a skill, weave in basic attacks to make use of the extra hit. Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker.
XinZhao.escape: Right after you make Xin Zhao use E Audacious Charge, you have an opportunity to go in. If you’ve taken two empowered basic attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, don’t continue the engage; get out of range with Viego W Spectral Maw before the third hit. Counterattack again after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge the stab from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side, then close the gap right after he uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Don’t fight while allowing the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike to land; counterattack after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s immunity ends. Focus on picking off a target you can kill to trigger Viego P Sovereign's Domination possession.
XinZhao.laning: Viego has difficulty closing in alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, engage when the enemy pushes the lane close to your allied turret. When chasing Xin Zhao, corner him somewhere with no target behind him for Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to dash to.
XinZhao.phase: Early, use Viego’s resource-free jungle clear to look for opportunities in lanes with allied crowd control. Mid game, as Viego completes items, is his peak; picking someone off in a small fight around an objective can turn the tide with a possession. Late game, don’t enter a front-to-front teamfight first as Viego; look for the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback can split your formation, so don’t stand too close to your allies. Go in after the enemy’s crowd control is used on an allied tank and a target you can kill appears, then secure the first corpse. During possession, use the basic abilities you gain, then target someone else with Viego R Heartbreaker before it ends or retreat to safety.

Zac.build: After completing one core item, fit Executioner's Calling into your build to counter the healing from Zac P Cell Division. Against Zac’s damage, build magic resistance rather than armor, and get movement speed to leave his telegraphed engage area.
Zac.combo: Approach with Viego E Harrowed Path. If you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot charging, interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw, then land Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. After landing a skill, weave in basic attacks to make use of the extra attack from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King. Before using Viego R Heartbreaker, remember that it hits the enemy with the lowest percentage of remaining health.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, you have a window to go in with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. If Zac is charging E Elastic Slingshot, interrupt him first with Viego W Spectral Maw’s stun, then engage.
Zac.fight: After making Zac use E Elastic Slingshot, close the gap with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker. Step on the blobs Zac drops to deny his healing and the cooldown reduction on Zac W Unstable Matter, then pick off a target you can kill to trigger Viego P Sovereign's Domination possession.
Zac.laning: Viego only has Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego E Harrowed Path to close in alone, so prioritize lanes with allied crowd control. If there are none, engage when the enemy pushes the lane close to your allied turret. If you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot charging, look for a chance to interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw.
Zac.phase: Viego has a comfortable early jungle clear and is strong when he secures the first kill in a small fight around an objective. Mid game, as he completes items, is his peak, so look for a fight while Zac P Cell Division’s revive is down. Late game, don’t enter a front-to-front teamfight first; wait until a target you can kill appears.
Zac.teamfight: Interrupt or absorb Zac’s engage with E Elastic Slingshot using Viego W Spectral Maw, then wait until crowd control is used on an allied tank. Pick off an enemy you can kill and possess with Viego P Sovereign's Domination to heal, then target someone else before the possession ends or retreat to safety.
Zac.watch: You can see Zac E Elastic Slingshot charging even from behind a wall, so interrupt it with Viego W Spectral Maw then or avoid the landing spot. If you get caught by the slow and knock-up from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, you can also take maximum-health-based damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, so create distance after his engage is absorbed.
